import { Cloud as CloudIcon, CloudRain as CloudRainIcon, CloudSun as CloudSunIcon, Moon as MoonIcon, Sun as SunIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Carousel, CarouselContent, CarouselItem, } from "@workspace/ui/components/carousel" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const hours = [ { time: "Now", temp: 18, icon: SunIcon }, { time: "1 PM", temp: 19, icon: SunIcon }, { time: "2 PM", temp: 19, icon: CloudSunIcon }, { time: "3 PM", temp: 17, icon: CloudIcon }, { time: "4 PM", temp: 16, icon: CloudRainIcon }, { time: "5 PM", temp: 15, icon: CloudRainIcon }, { time: "6 PM", temp: 14, icon: CloudIcon }, { time: "7 PM", temp: 13, icon: MoonIcon }, { time: "8 PM", temp: 12, icon: MoonIcon }, ] export default function HourlyForecastStrip() { return (
Hourly forecast Rain from 4 PM
{hours.map((hour, index) => (
{hour.time} {hour.temp}°
))}
) }
